# Fábio Magalhães — Go-to-Market Systems Architect · London

> Fractional Go-to-Market Systems Architect helping B2B scale-ups fix broken CRM, pipeline, and revenue forecast through AI-powered system design.

## Who I am
Fábio Magalhães is a fractional Go-to-Market Systems Architect working with VP Sales, CROs, and Founders at Series A–C B2B SaaS companies in the United Kingdom. Based in London.

## What I do
I rebuild the operating system behind scale-up revenue growth — fixing the CRM, pipeline, forecast, and execution layer so that sales, CS, and exec teams operate from a single source of truth.

Two engagement models:
- **Free 1-Week GTM Audit** — Bowtie stage diagnostic (CR1–CR8), CRM data quality review, AI automation opportunity map, stack overlap analysis, and prioritised fix roadmap. No cost, no pitch.
- **Fractional Go-to-Market Systems Support** — Embedded fractional architect on a monthly retainer. I design, build, and operate your revenue operating system ongoing. No full-time hire required.

## Specialisms
- Go-to-Market systems architecture and CRM design
- Salesforce and HubSpot architecture, governance, and cleanup
- Bowtie model diagnostics (CR1–CR8 customer lifecycle framework)
- AI sales automation (lead qualification, deal scoring, forecast agents, CS handoff)
- Pipeline forecasting and revenue visibility
- Revenue stack integrations (Clay, Gong, BigQuery, Snowflake, n8n, MuleSoft)
- AI agent deployment at each Bowtie stage

## Who I work with
Series A to Series C B2B SaaS companies in the UK. Typical buyer: VP Sales, CRO, Head of Sales Operations, or Founder-led GTM at 20–200 employees.

## Services
1. **Free 1-Week Go-to-Market Systems Audit** — no cost, no obligation
2. **Fractional Go-to-Market Systems Support** — ongoing monthly retainer, embedded
